item.title: Putin Owns Everything: The Kleptocracy Where Oligarchs Are Only Nominees
item.description: Tsarist Russia respected private property; Putin's Russia does not. Under him the ruler effectively owns everything — all the major wealth, assets and resources — and the famous billionaires are merely conditional, temporary nominees who would surrender their yachts, palaces and billions the instant he demanded them back. Oligarch money is therefore not wealth but delegated power, which is the real architecture of the regime.
